diagnostic_question: Classify recorded same-target teacher/student PLANT alternatives by Manhattan distance; inspect whether structurally similar encoded-step-2 teacher examples occur in sampled training archives.
training_scope: Raw numeric features and labels only, five selected members; do not decode archive seed member. Encoded step is not independently checked against original observation or callback ordinal.
historical_scope: Full compressed trace identity checked; JSON-parse only first 3 lines per trace. gzip may prefetch more bytes. Existing receipt and seed-role metadata are read in local memory.
privacy: Publish four-case aggregate categories as an explicit exception; training early-source categories only below_20/at_least_20 for farther and equal separately, never counts, union, all-step or combined. No individual identities, coordinates, private state, seeds, paths or input hashes. Thresholds are not formal anonymity.
acceptance: Four fixed traces and two registered archives; all source, schema, label, geometry, teacher and feature identities must match; stop on any failure.
independent_pre_review: Two reviewers; one ran all 24 checks, the other 23 synthetic checks plus an isolated synthetic-freeze import check.
interpretation: Only coarse sampled demonstration structure and four conditional choices; no exact source join, historical batch proof, model score explanation, causal reward or generalization.
concurrent_mutation_limitation: Operator separately checks Git registration and source before/after; no OS locking or proof of executed bytes.
